titles.title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
titles.synopsis: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

titles.title: Fallen Angels
titles.synopsis: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

titles.title: Little Hearts: Madness of Love
titles.synopsis: A broke, desperate filmmaker fakes a public proposal to chase online fame. It goes viral, turning into real love, real fallout, and a harsh choice feed the algorithm or protect his heart in a world where emotions are content, at any cost

titles.title: Relict
titles.synopsis: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

titles.title: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
titles.synopsis: Gen Takasegawa, the first Japanese actor to play the lead role at London's Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre, has been unable to return to Japan for some time. After two years, he finally makes his way back home, only to find out that he is suddenly and completely forgotten by the entire world.

titles.title: Capturing Bigfoot
titles.synopsis: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

titles.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
titles.synopsis: Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found.

titles.title: SOR
titles.synopsis: In the series *SOR*, every patient represents a unique story, and successive shifts demonstrate that no two cases in the ER are alike. Patients admitted to the hospital will include, for instance, a critically injured motorcyclist whose condition fails to improve despite standard procedures; doctors and paramedics will also fight to save the life of a well-known TV presenter, while teenagers involved in a serious electric scooter accident will also arrive at the unit. A major test for the entire team will be a bus crash that places the ER on high alert. A large number of critically injured patients will arrive simultaneously, forcing doctors to make split-second decisions on which lives depend.

titles.title: The Room Next Door
titles.synopsis: Ingrid and Martha were close friends in their youth, when they worked together at the same magazine. Ingrid went on to become an autofiction novelist while Martha became a war reporter, and they were separated by the circumstances of life. After years of being out of touch, they meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation.

titles.title: Driving Mom Crazy
titles.synopsis: Fiery livestreamer Zhang Ru-Yi unexpectedly finds herself pregnant but can’t remember who the father is. Her attempt to get an abortion fails mysteriously—turns out the heavenly stork, Peng Ying, is secretly sabotaging her. Overwhelmed by parenting, she gets unexpected help from her gangster landlord Ah Li and a nerdy ghost. Their chaotic yet ambiguous cohabitation takes wild turns. Later, Ru-Yi suffers from postpartum depression, nearly sending the baby to the hospital. In a bizarre twist, the baby is taken by gangsters, prompting a hilarious, heartwarming, and fantastical rescue mission with humans, ghosts, and gods!

titles.title: Super Scam Me
titles.synopsis: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

titles.title: Dreamland
titles.synopsis:
Ever since his moth­er died in a fire, Ter­rence has seclud­ed him­self in an emo­tion­less world.

He goes through his dai­ly teenag­er life apa­thet­i­cal­ly… with one excep­tion! The sim­ple sight of a flame plunges him into a world of fear, an awak­en ver­sion of his night­mares – for, every time he falls asleep, he help­less­ly relieves the trag­ic event, thus rekin­dling his pyro­pho­bia. Until that one night he can’t bear it any­more and stops run­ning away from the dev­il­ish flames. Lit­tle does he know that, by doing so, he over­came his great­est fear and became a Trav­el­er: a very spe­cial kind of Dream­er, able to explore Dream­land, the dimen­sion born from mankind’s dreams… and nightmares!

titles.title: Prahaar
titles.synopsis: Ujjwal Nikam is an Indian special public prosecutor who has worked on prominent murder and terrorism cases such as the 1993 Bombay bombings, the Gulshan Kumar murder case, the Pramod Mahajan murder case, and the 2008 Mumbai attacks.

titles.title: Street Fighter
titles.synopsis: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

titles.title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
titles.synopsis: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

titles.title: Whalefall
titles.synopsis: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

titles.title: Sacrifice
titles.synopsis: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

titles.title: Tenzing
titles.synopsis: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

titles.title: Brimstone Terrace
titles.synopsis: When a depressed public defender ends his own life, he is sentenced to an eternity in Hell. However, after Satan takes notice of his skills, he is offered an afterlife-changing deal that may not fall in line with his own values.

titles.title: Crawlers
titles.synopsis: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

titles.title: OM Chapter 1: Udhiram - The Blood Wood
La bola negra
titles.synopsis: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

titles.title: Clean Hands
titles.synopsis: The true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis and "the thin blue line" from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

titles.title: Therapy Done Right
titles.synopsis: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

titles.title: Breeder
titles.synopsis: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

titles.title: Sense and Sensibility
titles.synopsis: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

titles.title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
titles.synopsis: In Rio de Janeiro, Noah Silva is a smooth-talking, used-car salesman whose 'do whatever it takes' approach to business and life begins to unravel at home and at work. After a series of wake-up calls, Noah is forced to confront the cost of his choices. He begins a difficult and deeply personal journey to restore his integrity while trying to win back the hearts of his wife and son.

titles.title: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
titles.synopsis: An outsider fueled by relentless determination works his way into the inner circle of the Wu-Tang Clan, where his ambition and creativity converge in the making of an album poised to ignite global controversy.

titles.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
titles.synopsis: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

titles.title: Nayyi Navelli
titles.synopsis: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

titles.title: Transylvania Tapes
titles.synopsis: In 1997, Romanian actress Silvia Enescu mysteriously disappeared while searching for family property in Transylvania. All she left behind were a collection of home movies: the TRANSYLVANIA TAPES. Now, Silvia's daughter Mara travels from Los Angeles to Romania to discover what happened to her mother. With the help of her cameraman friend Dylan, Mara documents her journey, which takes her from the streets of Bucharest to the medieval town of Sighisoara, deep in the heart of Transylvania. Unearthing the truth about her mother comes at a terrible price, as Mara must escape an ancient family curse.

titles.title: Conceivable
titles.synopsis: When faced with an unexpected pregnancy, a couple in midlife must navigate their beliefs, relationships, and the support of their community. A compelling story that explores the complexities of family, faith, and the choices that define us.

titles.title: You Can't Leave
titles.synopsis: A young man (Boldman) searches for answers behind his sister’s mysterious disappearance. His journey leads him and a group of friends, including Olivia (Andino), deep into a remote forest where they become trapped in a supernatural prison. Hunted by shadowy entities, the group is forced to confront both physical and psychological terror as they struggle to escape

titles.title: You Can See Everything
titles.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

titles.title: Cabaret Boys
titles.synopsis: A fringe therapist takes the world by storm with a galaxy-brained new approach to self-help called the Jackman Method. Through immersive sessions, he transforms wayward young men into semi-employable outsider artists—all from the comfort of his posh home office in New York City. When an unhinged ex-patient returns to his care and is chosen to headline the practice’s first ever cabaret night, the fallout is immense. Diva behavior, grueling rehearsals, and public scandal threaten to destroy not only the show but the Jackman Method itself.

titles.title: Marília Mendonça: Sentimento Louco
titles.synopsis: The production portrays the life story and meteoric rise of one of the greatest voices in Brazilian *sertanejo* music: Marília Mendonça, the country's most-streamed female artist. The project traces the journey of a singer who defined a generation and changed the national music landscape forever. Through exclusive access to personal archives and testimonials from friends, family, and music industry colleagues, the production reveals the story behind a career built on authenticity, talent, and emotion. Marília won the hearts of countless fans with her charisma and her unconditional love for music.

titles.title: Friends Sex and Games
titles.synopsis: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

titles.title: Money Trap
titles.synopsis: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

titles.title: Jailer 2
titles.synopsis: Following the events of "Jailer",  former ruthless police officer Muthuvel Pandian must come face-to-face with an even larger threat.

titles.title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
titles.synopsis: A few mysterious men from Kochi arrive out of nowhere and whisk away the ever-baffling Eken Babu to Kerala. As confusion turns into curiosity, Eken finds himself at the centre of a bizarre new mystery.

titles.title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
titles.synopsis: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku is the much-awaited sequel to the 2024 all-time blockbuster Bohurupi, where Bikram and Jhimli return, stepping into a thrilling new chapter of adventure and high-stakes drama.

titles.title: The Storm
titles.synopsis: Filip is turning 45, and has invited his closest friends for dinner at his and his wife's lavish and newly bought farm estate up north in Sweden. What they don't know is that a ferocious storm is on its way and that they'll be trapped together. Their polished acts fall, and an unfiltered meltdown starts. When the panic starts to creep in and they all realise the seriousness of the situation, the farm starts to shrink, secrets spill out, and unexpected feelings take shape.

titles.title: Crystal Lake
titles.synopsis: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

titles.title: Hollywood Arts
titles.synopsis: Struggling actress Trina Vega returns to her former high school, Hollywood Arts, as an unqualified substitute teacher, quickly finding herself both clashing with and unexpectedly inspiring a new generation of ambitious and talented students as they learn to find their true path at Hollywood's most elite performing arts school.

titles.title: Love of Your Life
titles.synopsis: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

titles.title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
titles.synopsis: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

titles.title: VisionQuest
titles.synopsis: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

titles.title: The Trap
titles.synopsis: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

titles.title: Free Leonard Peltier
titles.synopsis: Leonard Peltier, one of the surviving leaders of the American Indian Movement, has been in prison for 50 years following a contentious conviction. A new generation of Native activists is committed to winning his freedom before he dies.

titles.title: Always Lalisa
titles.synopsis: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

titles.title: Intimate Bodies
titles.synopsis: Lisa has come home from a disappointing evening, feeling forlorn and friendless. What Lisa doesn't realize is someone is there waiting for her.

titles.title: The Goodie Bag
titles.synopsis: An undergrad embarks on a networking meeting with an older woman who might offer more than he signed up for.

titles.title: Grandmasters
titles.synopsis: The once esoteric and uninspired world of competitive chess is thrown into turmoil when an eccentric German entrepreneur enlists reigning champion Magnus Carlsen to launch a new league that aims to revolutionize the game, challenge the sport's governing body, and "make chess cool."

titles.title: Treasure Island
titles.synopsis: When Jim Hawkins gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess's clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger. Sailing aboard The Hispaniola, Jim and Bess are caught between the charming, terrifying pirate Long John Silver, and the debonair, duplicitous British agent Aaron Graham. Jim has to grow up fast as he and his mother fight for survival on a voyage where alliances shift, secrets multiply and peril closes in from all sides.

titles.title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026
titles.synopsis: The 2026 Money in the Bank, also promoted as Money in the Bank: New Orleans, is an upcoming professional wrestling premium live event produced by WWE. It will be the 17th annual Money in the Bank event and will take place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, in New Orleans, Louisiana. This will be the first Money in the Bank to be held in October, making it the latest scheduled Money in the Bank in a calendar year, and the first one to be held after SummerSlam.

titles.title: Ei Shohorer Gaan
titles.synopsis: Set against the vibrant backdrop of Kolkata, this emotional drama weaves together the lives of dreamers searching for love, purpose, and belonging. As their journeys intersect through art, relationships, and personal struggles, they discover the strength to hold on to hope in a city filled with chaos, heartbreak, and possibility.

titles.title: Analog Eyes
titles.synopsis: A loner dork gets fed up with the monotony of his existence under the shadow of his narcissistic friend. Forcing the the pair to reevaluate their place in life.

titles.title: Musk
titles.synopsis: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

titles.title: Matchbox the Movie
titles.synopsis: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

titles.title: The Beast
titles.synopsis: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

titles.title: Animals
titles.synopsis: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

titles.title: A Prayer for the Dying
titles.synopsis: In 1870 Friendship, Wisconsin, a small town of Scandinavian settlers still suffering the repercussions of the recent Civil War. When faced with a new and even deadlier threat, one man is forced to make a harrowing choice: save his young family or defend the community that gave him a second chance at life and meaning.

titles.title: The Social Reckoning
titles.synopsis: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

titles.title: Tenzing
titles.synopsis: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

titles.title: Udta Teer
titles.synopsis: Plot TBA.

titles.title: Misty Green
titles.synopsis: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

titles.title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
titles.synopsis: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds with authentic‑tasting Chinese food. But war breaks out, and local conditions take a drastic turn for the worse. No one can remain unaffected. What lies ahead for them? And how will the Dragon Restaurant hold on amid the war?

titles.title: Other Mommy
titles.synopsis: A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

titles.title: Fjord
titles.synopsis: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

titles.title: Double Trouble
titles.synopsis: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

titles.title: The Florist
titles.synopsis: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

titles.title: Monster Mia
titles.synopsis: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

titles.title: Treasure Trekkers
titles.synopsis: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

titles.title: Untitled Ahaan-Aneet-Mohit Suri Film
titles.synopsis: An upcoming Ahaan-Aneet-Mohit Suri film.

titles.title: Eh Din Roz Ni Aune
titles.synopsis: In a fortunate encounter, carefree 25-year-old Prabh meets Aavraj, a practical, successful 55-year-old businessman. Their contrasting ideologies create a fun-filled office-family drama. Prabh's mistakes and carefree nature challenge Aavraj's rigid personality, while secretary Rajdeep becomes the bridge between them. As Prabh learns practicality from Aavraj, Rajdeep discovers joy and emotional freedom through Prabh. With Rajdeep's help, Prabh creates a fictional world to heal the misunderstanding between Aavraj and his estranged daughter. Their reunion restores Aavraj's happiness and brings him emotionally closer to Prabh. Touched by Prabh's spirit, Aavraj finally supports his startup dream, completing their transformative journey.

titles.title: Angel and the Badman
titles.synopsis: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

titles.title: See Me
titles.synopsis: When his father refuses to stop reaching out, a young man groomed online at twelve must decide whether to finally let someone see what was left behind.

titles.title: V/H/S/Mixtape
titles.synopsis: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

titles.title: Bokshi
titles.synopsis: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

titles.title: Avatar: Seven Havens
titles.synopsis: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

titles.title: Take Charge of My Heart
titles.synopsis: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

titles.title: A Day Like No Other
titles.synopsis: The origins, career and music of Spanish singer Raphael inspire this intimate biopic series about his remarkable journey to 60 years of global success.

titles.title: Pentimento
titles.synopsis: On an errand to the Hamptons, an artist’s assistant makes an embarrassing mistake that pressures him to face his creative stagnation.

titles.title: Below
titles.synopsis: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

titles.title: Love of Your Life
titles.synopsis: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

titles.title: Less of a Stranger
titles.synopsis: A film inspired by the life of Polish rock legend Jan Borysewicz. A story of music, rebellion, and freedom in a world where dreams often collide with a grim reality.

titles.title: Carrie
titles.synopsis: Misfit teenager Carrie White has spent her life in seclusion with her domineering mother, Margaret. After her father's sudden death, Carrie finds herself contending with the challenges of attending public high school, a bullying scandal, and the emergence of mysterious telekinetic powers.

titles.title: Inside The Circle
titles.synopsis: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

titles.title: Land of Shadows
titles.synopsis: Following a tragic event that shattered her life, renowned author Alice Chevalier struggles to find meaning in her existence. Searching for answers and a sign from destiny, she meets Thomas, a mysterious man who offers her an experience that defies the boundaries of reality. Driven by the hope of rebuilding herself, Alice embarks on a mystical journey, like an astronaut venturing into the far reaches of the unknown.

titles.title: The Bridge
titles.synopsis: Young Israeli survivors of the October 7 attacks travel to Los Angeles for Rock ’n’ Roll Fantasy Camp, discovering healing and strength through music and shared resilience.

titles.title: Adore Him
titles.synopsis: Through cinematic reenactments that span salvation history and intimate modern-day interviews from around the world, this film explores the transforming power of meeting the Creator of the Universe face to face. From encountering the Ark of the Covenant as it traveled across the wilderness to bumping into Jesus as he taught in the marketplace, this story builds to a culmination in the Eucharist, and today millions are finding out how much God truly loves them as they adore Him in the Blessed Sacrament. He is here. Will you come?

titles.title: California Schemin'
titles.synopsis: After being ridiculed for their Scottish accents, two ambitious musicians reinvent themselves as American rappers and fool the British music industry into a lucrative record deal, only for their elaborate lie to unravel under the weight of instant fame.

titles.title: Pooja Meri Jaan
titles.synopsis: A girl named Pooja is being stalked by an unidentified admirer of her.

titles.title: Beware Boiúna
titles.synopsis: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

titles.title: Digger
titles.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

titles.title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
titles.synopsis: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

titles.title: Verity
titles.synopsis: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

titles.title: Nickels
titles.synopsis: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

titles.title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
titles.synopsis: A father makes a bad parenting choice by taking his young son to a wild hip-hop festival, leading to chaos as they navigate crowds, security, and family dynamics with eccentric companions.

titles.title: Ghost in the Cell
titles.synopsis: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

titles.title: Appofeniacs
titles.synopsis: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

titles.title: April X
titles.synopsis: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her. Ultimately descending into a violent criminal underworld and madness, Bax is forced to confront the cost of identity, love, and survival.

titles.title: Bird in Hand
titles.synopsis: Bird returns home to visit her mom in search of the perfect wedding venue after a surprise engagement to her longtime boyfriend, but much to everyone's surprise, she is actually on the hunt for something else.

titles.title: Doing Life
titles.synopsis: A single mother fighting for survival and a reformed ex-con with untapped talents forge an unexpected bond.

titles.title: Atonement
titles.synopsis: Based on Dexter Filkins’ resonant New Yorker article of the same name, about Marine Lu Lobello, haunted by memories of a deadly incident in Baghdad, whose journey of guilt and remorse leads him to reach out to Nora, the sole surviving member of the family he believes he may have harmed.

titles.title: The Last First: Winter K2
titles.synopsis: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

titles.title: The Actor
titles.synopsis: A young actor attempts to finish their self audition tape. But a series of never ending interruptions sends him into an existential spiral.

titles.title: Shabara
titles.synopsis: An adventure written in the stars and across time.

titles.title: Prem Keetanu
titles.synopsis: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

titles.title: The Influencer Project
titles.synopsis: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

titles.title: Bail
titles.synopsis: Bail is an upcoming Kannada action drama film directed by Pavan Wadeyar.

titles.title: Maharashtra Epstein Files
titles.synopsis: Plot TBA; inspired by the real-life scandal surrounding the self-styled godman Ashok Kharat alias 'Captain'.

titles.title: Pinaka
titles.synopsis: Pinaka (2026), Action Drama Fantasy Period Thriller in Kannada language

titles.title: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness
titles.synopsis: “Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness” is a feature documentary that explores all the major psychedelics, not just by explaining how they work medicinally, but by taking viewers inside dosing rooms for extremely rare looks at the remarkable power, emotion, and speed of psychedelic healing in action: from pro athletes repairing brain damage from concussions, to combat veterans finding relief from suicidal despair, to a woman breaking free from opioid addiction, to survivors of the Nova Music Festival massacre who say being on psychedelics during the attack shielded them from developing mental trauma.

titles.title: CAMPEÓN
titles.synopsis: Emma's life violently unravels as she is both the obsession of a narcissistic addict, and the fault line between identical brothers.

titles.title: Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend
titles.synopsis: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

titles.title: Kitti
titles.synopsis: A psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between reality, fear, and the human mind. When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.

titles.title: Journey
titles.synopsis: Roberto is a young man who is trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is the heart of his odyssey. Roberto on his path is constantly faced with the opportunity to quit and give in to defeat. However, it's the voice of those who came before him, which fuels his passion for Legacy

titles.title: Kill Jackie
titles.synopsis: Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

titles.title: Peccato
titles.synopsis: 2049. Emanuela Fanelli is 63 years old and lives alone in a small isolated mountain village in Valle d'Aosta. She doesn't act anymore, she shied away from cameras and has been forgotten by the showbiz. Through a ironic and speculative tone, Peccato interrogates on the reasons of the actress' retreat, by a "what if" narrative that goes back through Fanelli's carreer and the mysterious scandal that caused her downfall.

titles.title: Demonte Colony 3
titles.synopsis: Srini and Debbie set out to find a missing librarian, but their search soon leads them into a dark and mysterious world. As they uncover hidden secrets, they find themselves unraveling a sinister mystery far more dangerous than they imagined

titles.title: Mr. Bhaarath
titles.synopsis: Two siblings share a unique bond where, according to their zodiac signs, any good fortune experienced by one is believed to be reflected in the other's life. Believing in this connection, they decide to get married at the same time. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when one sibling's childish behavior creates a series of complications, leading to emotional and family conflicts that put both weddings at risk.

titles.title: Erie
titles.synopsis: Siblings Stella and Oscar return to their Pennsylvania hometown to investigate their sister Iris' unexplained death following a mysterious rise in suicides within the county.

titles.title: Baththa
titles.synopsis: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two, changing their lives forever.

titles.title: The Trial of Alec Baldwin
titles.synopsis: A provocative examination Alec Baldwin as he faces charges of manslaughter, with a cross-examination of the American legal system and the court of public opinion.

titles.title: Without Looking Back
titles.synopsis: A story about friendship and a crime that never happened. The main characters are Sonya and Zhenya. One day, they push a guy who was bothering them to the ground and, thinking they've killed him, go on the run.

titles.title: The Last First: Winter K2
titles.synopsis: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

titles.title: Acharya
titles.synopsis: An ex-Army man takes on a contract to rescue a young woman stranded in Mumbai and bring her safely back to Nepal. What begins as a straightforward rescue mission soon turns into a dangerous and unexpected journey.

titles.title: Switches
titles.synopsis: Jake and Dawn, a married couple sliding towards divorce. Two people who once had it all--the career momentum, the chemistry, the “it couple” energy-- are now buried under bills, resentment, and distance. Enter Switch, the trial drug from a hush-hush pharmaceutical company promising an “empathy revolution” by letting couples swap consciousness for 24 hours.

titles.title: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
titles.synopsis: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.

titles.title: Dust
titles.synopsis: Sam's curiosity about life and death deepens on a family backpacking trip, where we see nature, loss, and the cycle of existence through the lens of a six-year-old child.

titles.title: Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai
titles.synopsis: Caught between family duty and romantic love, a young man faces an impossible choice.

titles.title: East of Eden
titles.synopsis: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

titles.title: War
titles.synopsis: An anthology series set in the elite world of London law following two rival firms, Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne, as they face off in a different headline-making legal battle each season.

titles.title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
titles.synopsis: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

titles.title: Libera nos: Il trionfo sul male
Camp Duval
titles.synopsis: Welcome to Camp Duval, the wildest comedy camp ever created — where rising comics come to sharpen their jokes, survive the chaos, and hopefully make it through the night.

titles.title: NAZA
titles.synopsis: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.

titles.title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
titles.synopsis: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

titles.title: Private Eyes West Coast
titles.synopsis: Now leading different lives from their Toronto crime-fighting days, private investigators Matt Shade and Angie Everett encounter a world of different cases along with a new group of friends while solving cases in Victoria, British Columbia.

titles.title: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
titles.synopsis: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

titles.title: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
titles.synopsis: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

titles.title: Miller Night Football
titles.synopsis: Chronicles comedian Dennis Miller's unlikely arrival in the "Monday Night Football" (MNF) broadcast booth in 2000, alongside veteran sportscaster Al Michaels and former NFL quarterback Dan Fouts. Intended to reinvigorate the iconic television franchise and attract a broader audience, Miller's addition, and his distinctly cerebral brand of humor, was met with both intrigue and skepticism across sports and television.

titles.title: Crooked Miles
titles.synopsis: Desperate people receive a mystical gift that grants wishes, collects souls, and creates monsters.

titles.title: LEGO ONE PIECE
titles.synopsis: Usopp spins a tall tale about the Straw Hats' journey across the East Blue into the Grand Line before Chopper joined the crew.

titles.title: Outside
titles.synopsis: Going beyond the four walls, Outside is the latest spin-off from the Sidemen's smash-hit series Inside. A new group of content creators are thrown into the forest to battle for a prize of up to £1 million. With every comfort eating into the prize pot, they'll face brutal decisions, unpredictable challenges and plenty of Sidemen mischief as they fight to keep hold of the cash.

titles.title: The Vampires of New Orleans
titles.synopsis: The horrors of New Orleans history reverberate down to the present in this docudrama combining Southern Gothic terror with investigations into the city's real-life folklore.

titles.title: Peculiar Green
titles.synopsis: A middle-aged man with deity-like powers details the creation of his new world. A world characterized by a shade of green.

titles.title: Invention 13
titles.synopsis: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

titles.title: Peekers
titles.synopsis: While trying to get into the Christmas spirit Johnny has a horrifying encounter.

titles.title: Hellbilly Hollow
titles.synopsis: A team of paranormal YouTubers venture deep into the Alabama backwoods to film at a haunted attraction the day before Halloween. They encounter a sinister presence far more frightening - and deadlier - than specters and staged scares: Tickles and his caretaker brother Bull. One by one, the investigators, together with local thrill-seekers, fall victim!

titles.title: Long Day's Journey into Night
titles.synopsis: Over the course of a day, a married couple, Mary and James Tyrone, and their two sons, Jamie and Edmund, grapple with Mary's morphine addiction and confront each other over the past in a series of emotionally tense and volatile exchanges.

titles.title: Charlie Harper
titles.synopsis: The journey of a young woman, Harper, and a young man, Charlie, as they meet, leave their respective homes, and attempt to build a life together in a new city. As the driven and ambitious Harper works to build a career as a chef, and the brilliant-yet-stuck Charlie struggles to get himself on track, their relationship faces growing challenges.

titles.title: Heart of the Beast
titles.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

titles.title: Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha – Shri Ram Ki
Bloody Tennis
titles.synopsis: Sophie joins a prestigious tennis academy, where the brutality of competitive sports is taken to its extreme and only the hungriest survive.

titles.title: Village Rockstars 2
titles.synopsis: Dhunu, now in her late teens, still climbs trees, swims, and most importantly, dreams of continuing her childhood life as a guitarist in her rock band. However, life does not unfold as Dhunu wishes. As she faces the bitter and sour moments of life, she stands on the threshold of leaving her once-happy childhood behind.

titles.title: Primetime
titles.synopsis: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history, turning an undercover investigation into one of the most controversial cultural phenomena of the decade.

titles.title: The Vvaan
titles.synopsis: A rational urban man defies his ancestral forbidden forest & awakens a divine goddess, only to realise that some powers exist beyond logic & he must rise as the village’s only saviour to protect his people from annihilation.

titles.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
titles.synopsis: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

titles.title: UNABOMBER
titles.synopsis: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

titles.title: Don't Be Shy!
titles.synopsis: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

titles.title: Chiranjeevi Hanuman: The Eternal
titles.synopsis: An AI-generated film about the Hindu god Hanuman; it will draw from the sacred texts of Indian epic 'Ramayana' and Puranic literature to create what producers describe as an “awe-inspiring, visual odyssey designed to be enjoyed as a shared experience in theaters.”

titles.title: Meesaya Murukku 2
titles.synopsis: After facing rejection in love and getting into a fight, Jeeva learns about his father Siva's struggles and sacrifices. Inspired by his grandfather's legacy and father's dedication, Jeeva changes his outlook and works hard toward his musical dream. Through determination and perseverance, Jeeva earns recognition in the music industry and brings pride to his family.

titles.title: The Incomer
titles.synopsis: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

titles.title: The Stunt Driver
titles.synopsis: Based on the true story of Montrealer Ken Carter, the “Mad Canadian” stunt driver who tried to jump the Saint Lawrence River in a rocket car in the mid-’70s. Carter's dream was to end his 30-year career with a big jump, a big paycheck, and mega stardom. In the process of accomplishing it, he hired a big sports manager and enlisted the best in rocket car design, with the National Film Board of Canada filming a documentary leading up to the event.

titles.title: Dorothy
titles.synopsis: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

titles.title: Dhoomakethu
titles.synopsis: On the morning of his wedding, 36 year old Kuttan wakes from a disturbing dream about his own death. As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realizing that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself again.

titles.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
titles.synopsis: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

titles.title: Heggana Muddu
titles.synopsis: Upcoming Kannada Film from Daali Pictures

titles.title: How To Hide It
titles.synopsis: A moment of weakness after a humiliating breakup leads Zahra, a young Muslim woman to play a forbidden lottery ticket. Her chance at escape becomes a spiritual crisis. While her coworker dreams of riches, she’s certain Allah is watching and waiting.

titles.title: Aaram
titles.synopsis: Aaram is a gripping crime thriller that explores the fragile line between integrity and survival. Rooted in emotional realism and layered with investigative tension, the film unravels the psychological turmoil of an honest police officer trapped in a web of guilt, fear and moral conflict. With elements of suspense, human drama, and institutional power play, Aaram promises an intense cinematic experience.

titles.title: Never After Dark
titles.synopsis: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

titles.title: Love Lottery
titles.synopsis: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

titles.title: Showstopper
titles.synopsis: A young woman is trapped in the clutches of a musical-obssesed serial killer, having to perform for her life to free herself from the perfection she is expected to achieve.

titles.title: Autobi
titles.synopsis: A woman searching for her missing sister enters a cursed forest, where buried trauma and terrifying secrets blur the line between reality and nightmare.

titles.title: Begni Ronger Alo
titles.synopsis: Manasi Sinha's third directorial feature.  This is a story of a mother and her daughter, a tale of love, memory, and the delicate bond of identity. This is a story of a relationship bathed in an indescribable light, Begni ronger alo.

titles.title: Tujhya Aai La
titles.synopsis: An upcoming film. Plot TBA.

titles.title: Spark
titles.synopsis: An investigative journalist takes on a massive bank scam, challenging a powerful cop in the process. As he digs deeper , he uncovers a deadly conspiracy that leads straight to the hidden mastermind behind it all.

titles.title: Paolo
titles.synopsis: Follow working-class Paolo's unsettling intrusion into the life of Téophane Tolbiac, a young and up-and-coming politician.

titles.title: The Final Problem
titles.synopsis: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor who previously played Sherlock Holmes must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

titles.title: 4 Blocks Zero
titles.synopsis: Travel back to 1990s Berlin and discover the story of a family caught between bureaucracy, politics, and social exclusion, determined to build a new life in Germany.

titles.title: Hunkkaar: The Roar
titles.synopsis: A victim takes a courageous stand against a powerful godman accused of misconduct in an intense courtroom drama centered on her fight for justice.

titles.title: The Paradise
titles.synopsis: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalised tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

titles.title: Power Trip
titles.synopsis: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

titles.title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
titles.synopsis: Spidey and the Avengers' Halloween plans are turned upside down by the mysterious Hallows' Eve, who plays magical tricks on trick or treaters and plans to ruin Halloween forever.

titles.title: Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story
titles.synopsis: Built from an extraordinary archive - thousands of hours of raw home video footage shot across 35 years by DeSean's older brother Byron - this is an intimate, unfiltered portrait of a father and his two sons - their bond, their sacrifices, their conflicts, and their shared pursuit of a better life.

titles.title: A Different World
titles.synopsis: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at her parents' HBCU alma mater and finds their shadow difficult to escape. She sets out to build her own legacy – while having the time of her life – alongside a whole new generation of Hillman’s best and brightest.

titles.title: My Sad Dead
titles.synopsis: Emma can see the dead. But when her niece arrives, thousands of lives are shaken.

titles.title: Balaraw: Blood Island
titles.synopsis: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

titles.title: The Love Hypothesis
titles.synopsis: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

titles.title: Forgotten Island
titles.synopsis: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

titles.title: Take Me Home
titles.synopsis: Anna (Anna Sargent making her acting debut), a middle-aged Korean adoptee with a cognitive disability, cares for her aging parents in a fragile balance of meeting one another’s needs. Alongside her sister Emily (Ali Ahn) and her father (Victor Slezak), they must confront challenging questions about the future, but Anna remains determined to build a life where all of them can thrive.

titles.title: Wonka's The Golden Ticket
titles.synopsis: In this one-of-a-kind reality competition, lucky players step inside Wonka's Chocolate Factory to face unpredictable games, tests and temptations.

titles.title: Habeas Corpus
titles.synopsis: A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

titles.title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
titles.synopsis: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

titles.title: Bedford Park
titles.synopsis: Haunted by an abusive childhood, Audrey, a Korean American woman in her 30s, faces her emotional past. When her mother’s car accident brings her back to her parents’ home, she meets the man responsible for the accident. Their relationship builds, passions ignite, and they form a loving connection.

titles.title: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
titles.synopsis: Shelley Beattie, a Deaf woman and champion bodybuilder, found fame in the 1990s on the hit TV show American Gladiators, where she competed under the name "Siren" before her untimely death in 2008. While charismatic, gorgeous, and a fierce competitor, Beattie also battled personal demons, struggling with mental illness, addiction, and questions of her own identity. Framed by the insight of another Deaf woman in Hollywood who found herself in the spotlight at the same time, Academy Award-winning actress Marlee Matlin, the documentary unpacks the story of Shelley "Siren" Beattie and her complex legacy entwined with beauty, mental illness, and love.

titles.title: Boundless: The Man Who Became Human
titles.synopsis: Ben Greenfield taught millions how to master the body. This is the story of everything that mastery could not reach. What remains when a man can no longer outrun himself?

titles.title: Judge Judy: Unfiltered, Unforgettable
titles.synopsis: For three decades, JUDGE JUDY has been a fixture in homes across America and around the world, making Judge Judy one of the most recognizable and influential personalities in television history. Audiences worldwide know her razor-sharp wit, unwavering common sense and unmistakable courtroom authority, with an influence that extends far beyond television.

titles.title: Brothers
titles.synopsis: Hollywood actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

titles.title: Minerva Academy
titles.synopsis: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

titles.title: Castration Movie Chapter iii.ii Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift; a fragmentary passage
titles.synopsis: Izzy does everything in her power to stop her partner from transitioning.

titles.title: Youth
titles.synopsis: A 50-year-old divorcee searches for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.

titles.title: Dasher
titles.synopsis: A down-and-out food delivery driver, Josh, and a fiery restaurant worker, Kayla, team up for a comedic and chaotic night of deliveries. Demanding customers, stolen sushi, and the festive mayhem on Christmas Eve push some life back into their lives and get them to dream just a bit more. Set in urban Honolulu, DASHER is a local take on what’s likely a nationwide story for young people living the gig economy – where working long hours just to get by discourages any life beyond the next gig.

titles.title: NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY  SEOUL - THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS
titles.synopsis: Back after almost two years, NCT 127's fifth tour,  NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY : SEOUL - THE REDLINE’, is coming live to cinemas!  Experience the explosive energy, world-class performances, and electrifying atmosphere of KSPO DOME brought to life on the big screen with immersive sound.  NCTzens, join us for the spectacular kickoff of 'THE REDLINE'!

titles.title: American Hostage
titles.synopsis: A psychological thriller anthology series focusing on a different hostage case every season.

titles.title: Karmakhya
titles.synopsis: A mysterious visit to a grieving family pulls a young woman into a terrifying world of secrets, black magic, and haunting illusions. As disturbing events begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare, Kaamakhya finds herself trapped in a chilling chain of events rooted in a dark past that refuses to stay buried.

titles.title: Falling
titles.synopsis: Alone in the suffocating quiet of his surrogate sister’s apartment, fifteen-year-old Analu clings desperately to memories of his lost loved one, Iolani, the one person who made him feel seen. The night becomes a battleground of haunting flashbacks and quiet suffering, as Analu teeters between holding on and letting go. Malu, his surrogate sister, fights to reach the part of him still holding on. Falling is a raw, intimate journey through trauma, where the weight of the past threatens to eclipse the connections that remain.

titles.title: ENVY
titles.synopsis: When Molly, a timid freshman ballerina, befriends Alison, an older girl in her class, the line between adoration and obsession starts to blur.

titles.title: Lust Stories 3
titles.synopsis: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

titles.title: Cursed Waters
titles.synopsis: After their ship is sunk in a naval battle, a group of pirates flee to a nearby island. However, the island is more than it seems. As they try to evade capture by the navy they soon find that the island is inhabited by a terrifying cult. What other secrets does this island hold? Can the pirates survive? Can they escape?

titles.title: Bad Apples
titles.synopsis: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

titles.title: Daayra
titles.synopsis: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

titles.title: Sunny Dancer
titles.synopsis: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

titles.title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
titles.synopsis: Martin Short, Eugene Levy, Gilda Radner, Victor Garber, Paul Shaffer, and other entertainment icons got their start in a 1972 Toronto production of the musical Godspell. Featuring interviews with the surviving cast members, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Mike Myers, and more, the film recounts a pivotal moment in comedy history, in hilarious, moving, and inspiring detail. Executive produced by Judd Apatow.

titles.title: It's a Medical Miracle
titles.synopsis: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

titles.title: The Weight
titles.synopsis: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

titles.title: Irumudi
titles.synopsis: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

titles.title: Hari Ka Om
titles.synopsis: Hari Prasad and his son Om are separated because of ideological differences. When Hari suffers a heart attack one morning and announces that he is going to die in six days, his wish to take his last breath at Kashi (Varanasi) with his elder son Om sets them on a destined journey to heal their dysfunctional relationship.

titles.title: Goody Goody
titles.synopsis: Lulled into a necessary sense of comfort during a long home birth process, expecting parents and their midwife begin to realize that something may be horribly wrong. As labor complications ensue, a blizzard rages outside trapping the family in their home – sitting ducks for whatever sinister presence might be in there with them.

titles.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom

titles.title: Tribeca 25
titles.synopsis: 25 years after 9/11, discover how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, explore how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

titles.title: Pidha Pachhi...
titles.synopsis: A spontaneous trip takes four friends down a wildly unexpected path after a drunken night ends in missing memories, accidental crimes and nonstop chaos. As they retrace their steps, every discovery makes their hilarious situation even worse.

titles.title: Mighty Mary
titles.synopsis: Mighty Mary chronicles an amazing group of “we eat nails for breakfast” type of women: the first all-women’s sailing team to contend for the famed America’s Cup, the holy grail for one of sport’s most elite and exclusive racing events.  This team was groundbreaking, beginning with an advertisement in the New York Times.  From there, a group of world class and Olympic sailors as well as Olympic rowers came together, a team which included a deaf sailor, a Native Hawaiian sailor, and the first African American sailor to ever win an America’s Cup race (as a coach of this novice, erstwhile team).  What was dismissed as a publicity stunt turned into something unimaginable. This motley crew (sailing aboard Mighty Mary) stunningly eliminated Stars & Stripes from contention. However, a secret backroom deal the night before the race upended that result. This is a true underdog story about a team which reshaped what could be possible in a sport that had long been inaccessible.

titles.title: Ghun Gaon
titles.synopsis: Shanaya, a wildlife photographer, travels alone to the remote village of Ghun Gaon to photograph a rare black leopard. However, she soon discovers a far more sinister and unsettling presence lurking deep within the jungle.

titles.title: Ozhiyathe
titles.synopsis: In August 1976, 19 schoolboys from Koduvayoor were arrested without cause and tormented for 21 days under the Emergency. Ozhiyathe brings this unrecorded true story of injustice and resilience finally to light.

titles.title: Adkitta
titles.synopsis: A babysitter's unexpected stay transforms a family's life and relationships.

titles.title: Barood
titles.synopsis: Barood is a story of today's youngsters being exploited by corruption. Jui, an innocent girl, falls in love with a loafer Shaon. And this turns Shaon's life upside down. The lovebirds wish to live a fairytale life but the circumstances are against them. In the race between love and society - who wins?

titles.title: Cosmic Symphony
titles.synopsis: Four iconic instruments, including The Wizard of Oz and A Star Is Born pianos, all lost in the 2025 Los Angeles Fires, are celebrated by their musicians, culminating in an animated send-off towards an imagined future, a Cosmic Symphony. Directed by Oscar-nominated composer Laura Karpman, and featuring John Clayton, Susie Chung, Starr Parodi and Diane Warren, Cosmic Symphony explores a truth that every musician knows - musical instruments have souls.

titles.title: The Revolutionaries
titles.synopsis: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

titles.title: The Trial
titles.synopsis: A teenager and her father struggle for justice after she is sexually assaulted by the scion of a successful businessman. Not only will the father and daughter have to navigate a failed judicial system, but they must also contend with a wealthy adversary bent on using all his power to protect his son.

titles.title: Honor Thy Mother
titles.synopsis: After years of estrangement, a mother and daughter find themselves on opposite sides of a bitter contest for what each believes is rightfully hers. Old wounds resurface as they weigh whether to confront the past together or let it drive them further apart.

titles.title: Operation Deception
titles.synopsis: Follows a controversial undercover operation that sent Alain Olivier, a drug-addicted Quebec forestry student, to death row in Thailand in 1989.

titles.title: Physical 100: Italy
titles.synopsis: One hundred Italian athletes face brutal physical challenges, each battling to outlast the rest and claim the glory of becoming the one true champion.

titles.title: Ali Baba Aur 40 Bhoot
titles.synopsis: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

titles.title: Stolen Heartbeats
titles.synopsis: After an attack leaves a woman named Anabel comatose, she and Rafael—a nurse who has the unique ability to hear the dead—must work together to keep her alive while hiding from her enemies.

titles.title: The Pandemic Prophet
titles.synopsis: When Professor Didier Raoult promotes a "miracle cure" for COVID-19, six ordinary citizens go after the truth -- including his own daughter.

titles.title: Sardar 2
titles.synopsis: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

titles.title: Mandaadi
titles.synopsis: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

titles.title: Maremma
titles.synopsis: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.

titles.title: Norton Creek Massacre
titles.synopsis: It's 1998. Deep in the pine forests outside a sleepy North Carolina town in Norton Creek, A loner has spent his whole life dreaming of being a killer. His only real friend is Dron, a towering, near silent, monstrous juggernaut. Together they cause destruction on locals, and a group of vampires passing by.

titles.title: The Uprising
titles.synopsis: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

titles.title: The Ordinary Jackpot
titles.synopsis: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

titles.title: Crew Girl
titles.synopsis: After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

titles.title: Chumbak
titles.synopsis: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

titles.title: The Perfect Lie
titles.synopsis: When one of their own is killed in a house fire, four picture-perfect couples are forced to question everything they thought they knew about each other.

titles.title: LOL Next
titles.synopsis: Spin-off of the hit series "LOL: Last One Laughing", hosted by Hazel Brugger.

titles.title: A Killer Story
titles.synopsis: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

titles.title: Hope
titles.synopsis: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

titles.title: Drawn Together
titles.synopsis: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

titles.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
titles.synopsis: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

titles.title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
titles.synopsis: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

titles.title: Last Seen
titles.synopsis: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

titles.title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
titles.synopsis: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

titles.title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
titles.synopsis: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

titles.title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
titles.synopsis: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

titles.title: Biff the Human Slayer
titles.synopsis: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.

titles.title: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
titles.synopsis: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

titles.title: Dang!
titles.synopsis: After their sister Ruthie blows up her perfect life, Andrew and Eunice show her the fun in being flawed as she helps them adult.

titles.title: Bobby Flay’s The Line
titles.synopsis: Chef Bobby Flay is pulling back the curtain on the high-stakes realities of working on a restaurant line. In the new competition series, we get to watch Bobby lead his hand-picked home team of extraordinary chefs — Antonia Lofaso, Michael Jenkins and Claudette Zepeda — against some of the country’s most acclaimed restaurant staffs. These dueling lines must execute a flawless dinner service for real diners in real time. If the visiting restaurant team prevails, they'll win $25,000.

titles.title: Runner
titles.synopsis: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

titles.title: Wild Tamil Nadu
titles.synopsis: Wild Tamil Nadu is a spectacular new natural history film that reveals the extraordinary biodiversity of Tamil Nadu- a land where rainforests, reefs, and deserts meet in one of the most unique ecological landscapes on Earth.

titles.title: The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift
titles.synopsis: Between 2001 and 2010, separated by thousands of miles, the victims shared one connection: they were all associated with Hooters. The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift is a two-hour documentary that unravels these tragic murders, exposing how young women who were linked to the iconic restaurant chain were preyed upon.

titles.title: Parched
titles.synopsis: When the water runs out during the journey.

titles.title: OJ Unseen: Exploitation of Evil
titles.synopsis: A decade after O.J. Simpson was controversially acquitted of the murders of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ron Goldman, he attempted to rebrand himself as a reality TV star with the hidden camera prank PPV special Juiced.

titles.title: Collision
titles.synopsis: When business magnate Miguel Ángel dies in a mysterious crash, his daughter Zoé and estranged wife Belén fight for control of his company.

titles.title: Fan Level Midnight: Devoted to The Office
